description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.021 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Compare npm package download trends for up to 5 packages. Returns total downloads and week-over-week trend for the requested period (last-week, last-month, last-year). Useful for evaluating package adoption before adding a dependency, comparing competing libraries (express vs fastify, react-query vs tanstack-query), or tracking whether a package is growing or declining. Free upstream: api.npmjs.org (no key required).
